# BuniAfrika CBO

> BuniAfrika CBO is a non-governmental community-based organization headquartered in Mombasa, Kenya, bridging research, civic technology, and cultural heritage preservation.

## Core Mandate & Focus Areas
- **CivicTech Awareness**: Educating communities on civic technologies, digital accountability, transparency, digital rights, and open governance.
- **Culture and Heritage**: Preserving African cultural identity, oral traditions, community histories, and indigenous knowledge through community documentation.
- **Evidence-Based Civic Action**: Translating rigorous grassroots research and policy analysis into actionable community advocacy.

- [About BuniAfrika](https://buniafrika.co.ke/about.php): Background, history, core values, leadership team, and operational partners.
- [Vision & Mission](https://buniafrika.co.ke/mission-vision.php): Strategic vision, mission statement, and institutional objectives.
- [Programmes & Thematic Areas](https://buniafrika.co.ke/programmes.php): Detailed breakdown of civic tech, heritage initiatives, and community FAQs.
- [Publications & Research](https://buniafrika.co.ke/publications.php): Policy briefs, research papers, baseline reports, and annual publications.
- [Volunteer & Fellowship Opportunities](https://buniafrika.co.ke/volunteer.php): Community fellowships, volunteer tracks, and application portal.
- [Contact & Offices](https://buniafrika.co.ke/contact.php): Headquarters location in Mombasa, Kenya, official emails, and communication channels.
